GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Soils as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.

6. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   C. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   B. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   D. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Weathering is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weathering.
   B. Say Weathering never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Weathering with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Weathering as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   B. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   C. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Water Cycle and Action of Rivers is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Water Cycle and Action of Rivers never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Water Cycle and Action of Rivers as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Water Cycle and Action of Rivers.
   D. Explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.
   D. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Tourism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
